Title: Skyward Signal
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Teal seats, small window, silver afternoon
Your coat on the armrest, our flight leaving soon
I check the little light above the cabin door
You catch my sideways smile and ask what that was for
My voice on the intercom, warm through the wire
A perfectly ordinary welcome with a spark of fire
No secret code to memorize, no part to rehearse
We carry our own gravity across the turning earth

[Chorus]
Send me that skyward signal
Green light through the blue
I have a seat beside me
And I saved the view for you
Let the little world get smaller
Let the wide horizon grow
With your hand across the armrest
We've got everywhere to go

[Verse 2]
A paper cup of coffee makes a circle on the tray
You draw a tiny lemon while the clouds drift away
The silver wing keeps time against a field of white
And every borrowed hour feels like something we can write

[Chorus]
Send me that skyward signal
Green light through the blue
I have a seat beside me
And I saved the view for you
Let the little world get smaller
Let the wide horizon grow
With your hand across the armrest
We've got everywhere to go

[Bridge]
No grand arrival, no velvet rope
Just two names on a ticket and a pocketful of hope

[Final Chorus]
Send me that skyward signal
Green light through the blue
I have a seat beside me
And I saved the view for you
We've got everywhere to go

Title: Two Points and a Grin
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sun on the bleachers, dust in the light
One more practice on a Tuesday night
Your yellow shirt, my water by the wall
You say keep watching, then you steal the ball
A crooked scoreboard, squeaky little shoes
A friendly competition neither has to lose
You take a bow before the shot goes in
I fold my arms and try to hide a grin

[Chorus]
Two points and a grin
Here we go again
Throw me that ridiculous look
And pull me back in
We can miss the basket
We can call it art
There's room for a little nonsense
In a serious heart

[Verse 2]
Red track pants and a ribbon come untied
We take a breather sitting side by side
You draw a play with a finger on my palm
The grand strategy is mostly keep me calm
Then off you go with that theatrical stride
Calling your own name like the crowd is multiplied
I clap so loud the empty rafters ring
An ordinary evening doing extraordinary things

[Chorus]
Two points and a grin
Here we go again
Throw me that ridiculous look
And pull me back in
We can miss the basket
We can call it art
There's room for a little nonsense
In a serious heart

[Bridge]
Nobody's keeping a permanent score
Put down the whistle, give us one round more

[Final Chorus]
Two points and a grin
Here we go again
There's room for a little nonsense
Let the good time in

Title: Red Planet Holiday
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Red dust on the landing steps
A silver helmet in your hands
I packed a bright red jumpsuit
You packed improbable plans
The hatch swings wide to nothing
But a peach-colored afternoon
We try a little moonwalk
On a planet with two moons

[Chorus]
Red planet holiday
Half a sky away
You and me making footprints
Where the quiet used to stay
Spin the little radio
Let the antennas sway
No appointment with the ordinary
On a red planet holiday

[Verse 2]
You make the first official speech
I interrupt with a wave
The flag we brought is laughter
And the souvenir we save
Is a picture through the porthole
With your shoulder next to mine
The galaxy is enormous
But our table seats just fine
We pour two cups of something
From a pouch with a peculiar name
You say the room could use a plant
And I am glad you came

[Chorus]
Red planet holiday
Half a sky away
You and me making footprints
Where the quiet used to stay
Spin the little radio
Let the antennas sway
No appointment with the ordinary
On a red planet holiday

[Bridge]
Ground control can hear us humming
There is nothing wrong down here
We are taking in the distance
Keeping one another near

[Final Chorus]
Red planet holiday
Half a sky away
You and me making footprints
On a red planet holiday

Title: Table for One More
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A violet lamp above the band
A candle trembling by your hand
The room is full of little conversations
I settle close beside the microphone
And find the face that makes the room feel home
No need for any polished explanation
A hat tipped back, a quiet count of four
I sing the song you haven't heard before

[Chorus]
Keep a table for one more
When the last applause is through
I will leave the light above the stage
And come sit down with you
Let the trumpets have their whisper
Let the coffee lose its steam
There is room beside your evening
For the rest of our small dream

[Verse 2]
The bass draws circles in the air
You lift a glass as if you're there
To toast the way the melody keeps turning
I miss a word and laugh instead
You nod along and tilt your head
It seems the room can wait while we are learning
The finest note is sometimes left unsung
The kind that hangs between a smile and tongue

[Chorus]
Keep a table for one more
When the last applause is through
I will leave the light above the stage
And come sit down with you
Let the trumpets have their whisper
Let the coffee lose its steam
There is room beside your evening
For the rest of our small dream

[Bridge]
Fold the stand, close the case
Leave a little silence in its place

[Outro]
One more chair, one more minute
And you in it

Title: Weather in the Glass
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Lightning writes across the window
Silver letters on the night
The old chair holds the center
Of a square of borrowed light
I turn it with a steady hand
And let the music take its time
You lean against the doorway
Keeping watch with that small smile
No thunder gets the final word
No flash can tell us when to move
We set a rhythm on the floor
And give the room a different groove

[Chorus]
Let the weather stay in the glass
Let the heavy clouds roll past
There is a beat beneath the noise
There is a place to use my voice
When the lights come up again
You will see me where I stand
Let the weather stay in the glass
We've got this moment in our hands

[Verse 2]
A heel turns, a shoulder follows
A slow arc across the chair
Nothing here is quite a victory
Just a good night to be there
You mark the count against your sleeve
I catch it on the second try
The room becomes a little harbor
While the rain rehearses sky

[Chorus]
Let the weather stay in the glass
Let the heavy clouds roll past
There is a beat beneath the noise
There is a place to use my voice
When the lights come up again
You will see me where I stand
Let the weather stay in the glass
We've got this moment in our hands

[Outro]
A slow turn, a long breath
The music has a little left

Title: Open Every Window
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Gold on the rafters, heat in the room
The big fan turns like a lazy moon
A pink sleeve catches the morning sun
Somebody laughs and the count begins at one
You wave from the rail on the mezzanine
The friendliest balcony I've ever seen
We leave a little room between each pair
And send the same bright rhythm through the air

[Chorus]
Open every window
Let the whole room breathe
Pass the little spark around
And leave some light for me
Shoulder to shoulder
Everybody gets a turn
Open every window
We've got something good to learn

[Verse 2]
A hand goes left and another goes right
We trade our tiny stumbles for delight
Nobody is perfect in the second row
That is how we know we have a real live show
The city outside is keeping other time
Inside the afternoon is yours and mine
You climb down the stairs when the break is due
I save a paper cup and half an orange for you

[Chorus]
Open every window
Let the whole room breathe
Pass the little spark around
And leave some light for me
Shoulder to shoulder
Everybody gets a turn
Open every window
We've got something good to learn

[Bridge]
The floor remembers every step
And none of them are wasted yet

[Final Chorus]
Open every window
Let the whole room breathe
Pass the little spark around
And leave some light for me

Title: Out of Office, In the Groove
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Blue folder, red folder, paper in a tray
The copier is singing in its own peculiar way
You look up from the spreadsheet with a carefully straight face
I bring the quarterly report and dance it into place
The glasses are professional, the grin is rather less
The meeting has been moved to an address called happiness
We tap the corner of the desk and count the rhythm in
The afternoon committee has approved a little spin

[Chorus]
Out of office, in the groove
Put the dullest hour on the move
No further comments, motion passed
Make this little good time last
Stamp the date and close the drawer
We have better things in store
Out of office, in the groove
Save the chair beside you, I'll come through

[Verse 2]
The binders make a rainbow on the ordinary shelf
You say the team could use a break, I volunteer myself
A tidy stack of deadlines can survive a cup of tea
The world will keep on turning for a minute without me
I leave a tiny doodle where your sticky notes were blue
A lemon wearing spectacles with love enclosed for you

[Chorus]
Out of office, in the groove
Put the dullest hour on the move
No further comments, motion passed
Make this little good time last
Stamp the date and close the drawer
We have better things in store
Out of office, in the groove
Save the chair beside you, I'll come through

[Outro]
Meeting adjourned, the floor is yours
Let's take the long way out the doors

Title: Side Door Smile
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Magenta on the pavement, velvet on the rope,
You straighten up my collar like a private little joke.
The coats arrive together, a ripple through the crowd,
Somebody calls for serious; we laugh a little loud.
A camera catches glitter, you catch my wandering eye.

[Chorus]
Meet me in the side door smile,
Keep that little look a while.
Flashbulbs get the silver shine,
You get the punchline every time.
Hand in hand beyond the frame,
Nothing here to prove or claim.

[Verse 2]
Our friends parade their jackets, the doorman hums the beat,
A taxi paints a yellow streak across the rain-washed street.
I sign a paper program with a lopsided heart,
You tell me that my autograph resembles modern art.
There goes my grand entrance; there goes your perfect grin.

[Chorus]
Meet me in the side door smile,
Keep that little look a while.
Flashbulbs get the silver shine,
You get the punchline every time.
Hand in hand beyond the frame,
Nothing here to prove or claim.

[Bridge]
Let the lenses find the colors,
Let the speakers shake the floor.
We can have our splendid entrance,
Then find somewhere quiet to talk some more.

[Final Chorus]
Meet me in the side door smile,
Keep that little look a while.
Flashbulbs get the silver shine,
You get the punchline every time.
Hand in hand beyond the frame,
Nothing here to prove or claim.

[Outro]
One step past the velvet line,
There it is, that smile of mine.

Title: Pocketful of Applause
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I tilt my hat to the balcony,
A golden circle waits for me.
The curtain gives a velvet sigh,
Two ribbons draw across the sky.
You lean against the front-row rail,
My grand announcement loses its tail.
I nearly miss the opening cue,
Because I caught a wink from you.

[Chorus]
Pocketful of applause,
Hat full of improbable stars.
Bow once, pass it around,
Hear how our laughter sounds.
Round goes the spotlight, warm goes the room,
Saving a cheer for you.

[Verse 2]
The trumpet takes a crooked turn,
The footlights make the sequins burn.
A silver scarf becomes a flower,
We stretch a minute to an hour.
I welcome every distant seat,
The balcony begins to beat.
But when I toss my hat your way,
You wear it better, I must say.

[Chorus]
Pocketful of applause,
Hat full of improbable stars.
Bow once, pass it around,
Hear how our laughter sounds.
Round goes the spotlight, warm goes the room,
Saving a cheer for you.

[Bridge]
No vanishing act for the finale,
Just open hands and a curtain call.
Bring the whole delighted company;
There's plenty of room to bow with us all.

[Final Chorus]
Pocketful of applause,
Hat full of improbable stars.
Bow once, pass it around,
Hear how our laughter sounds.
Round goes the spotlight, warm goes the room,
Saving a cheer for you.

[Outro]
One for the band, one for the crew,
And one ridiculous wink for you.

Title: Curbside Constellations
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The driver holds the door beneath a restless hotel sign,
A hundred colored promises go flickering down the line.
My cap is pulled a little low, your jacket smells of rain,
We watch the palms make shadows on the limousine again.
You ask if I am hungry. I say terribly, of course.

[Chorus]
Curbside constellations, easy conversation,
Your hand finding mine beneath the blue.
Let the city keep its glitter,
Let our coffee taste bitter,
I like arriving here with you.

[Verse 2]
We could take the marble staircase, we could find the grand buffet,
But the diner on the corner has a window facing west.
You unfold a paper napkin, draw a map across the gray,
Add a crooked little arrow to the place you like the best.
I keep it in my pocket, our itinerary in ink.

[Chorus]
Curbside constellations, easy conversation,
Your hand finding mine beneath the blue.
Let the city keep its glitter,
Let our coffee taste bitter,
I like arriving here with you.

[Bridge]
No grand occasion on the calendar,
No sparkling speech we need to make.
Just two chairs beside a window,
And all the time a small decision takes.

[Final Chorus]
Curbside constellations, easy conversation,
Your hand finding mine beneath the blue.
Let the city keep its glitter,
Let our coffee taste bitter,
I like arriving here with you.

[Outro]
The hotel lights can wait a minute,
There's a booth with both of us in it.

Title: Velvet Orbit
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They hung a golden star above a sea of folding chairs,
I climbed into the painted sky with denim underneath.
A river of pink fabric floated softly through the air,
You pointed out my crooked bow and tried to hide your teeth.
I laughed until the spotlight had to follow every shake.

[Chorus]
Velvet orbit, waving from the light,
I see your smile from any borrowed height.
Keep a little corner down below,
When the music brings me earthward, that's the place I'll go.

[Verse 2]
The orchestra is turning like a carousel of glass,
The rafters hold the glitter that the curtains couldn't keep.
I trace a little crescent with my finger as you pass,
You answer with a paper star you folded in your seat.
It isn't constellations that make this distance feel so small.

[Chorus]
Velvet orbit, waving from the light,
I see your smile from any borrowed height.
Keep a little corner down below,
When the music brings me earthward, that's the place I'll go.

[Bridge]
Lower the rigging slowly,
Let the final chord unwind.
I've been sitting in the heavens,
But our coats are waiting side by side.

[Final Chorus]
Velvet orbit, waving from the light,
I see your smile from any borrowed height.
Keep a little corner down below,
When the music brings me earthward, that's the place I'll go.

[Outro]
Fold your paper star for me,
We'll put it somewhere we can see.

Title: Under the Avenue
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Down beneath the avenue, the doorway breathes a kick,
Gold mosaics catch the beam and throw it back in bits.
You tug my knitted cap straight; I undo your careful work,
The DJ finds a little gap and fills it with a smirk.
Our jackets brush together as we find a patch of floor.

[Chorus]
Under the avenue, over the everyday,
Two hearts making room for a little more play.
Turn with me, laugh with me, let the rhythm move,
There's a whole bright room under the avenue.

[Verse 2]
Somebody's celebrating, someone brought the whole cafe,
A stranger guards our glasses while we dance the time away.
You make a sweeping gesture like a very fancy guide,
I follow with a bow that sends the table laughing wide.
The arches hold the echo of a hundred different cheers.

[Chorus]
Under the avenue, over the everyday,
Two hearts making room for a little more play.
Turn with me, laugh with me, let the rhythm move,
There's a whole bright room under the avenue.

[Bridge]
When the streetlights change above us,
We will barely know they do.
There's a city full of stories,
And this chapter has a beat for two.

[Final Chorus]
Under the avenue, over the everyday,
Two hearts making room for a little more play.
Turn with me, laugh with me, let the rhythm move,
There's a whole bright room under the avenue.

[Outro]
Up the stairs when morning's due,
Still humming underneath the avenue.

Title: Eight Counts of Sunlight
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Eight counts of sunlight on the warehouse floor,
My denim catches sparks when I come through the door.
Somebody tapes an arrow, somebody checks the sound,
I set my water by your chair and take another round.
You wear my tinted glasses, looking outrageously pleased.

[Chorus]
Eight counts of sunlight,
Room for a turn and a grin.
Ours for the afternoon,
Let's see what the day lets in.
Start with our rhythm,
Make something bright on the spot.

[Verse 2]
We mark the tricky section with a laugh and one more try,
The drummer taps his pencils while a cloud goes drifting by.
I sketch a different ending with a shoulder and a slide,
You count the final measure, then you join me at my side.
The windows look like cinema, the dust like lazy gold.

[Chorus]
Eight counts of sunlight,
Room for a turn and a grin.
Ours for the afternoon,
Let's see what the day lets in.
Start with our rhythm,
Make something bright on the spot.

[Bridge]
No sequins for the rehearsal,
No curtain hiding the seams.
Just a very good afternoon,
And a room where we can try our schemes.

[Final Chorus]
Eight counts of sunlight,
Room for a turn and a grin.
Ours for the afternoon,
Let's see what the day lets in.
Start with our rhythm,
Make something bright on the spot.

[Outro]
Leave the arrow on the floor,
We might want eight counts more.

Title: Emerald Hour
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The bulbs around the stage are doing their best impression
Of a thousand tiny suns at a very late convention.
I set a chair beside the band and check the emerald shine,
You tap the table twice to say the opening beat is mine.
The bartender is dancing with a towel upon her arm.

[Chorus]
Emerald hour, let the brass come through,
Green sparkle and a front-row view.
I'll send a rhythm, you send a smile,
We'll make this room dance for a while.

[Verse 2]
A turn around the chair, then a flourish to the bass,
Your laugh is getting louder than the cymbal in this place.
The drummer steals my spotlight with a wonderfully rude fill,
I answer with a shoulder shake, the audience goes still,
Then everybody claps as if we planned it all along.

[Chorus]
Emerald hour, let the brass come through,
Green sparkle and a front-row view.
I'll send a rhythm, you send a smile,
We'll make this room dance for a while.

[Bridge]
Bring the horns down to a whisper,
Let the kick drum walk alone.
I can hear you counting with me,
Now we give the room its chorus back in gold.

[Final Chorus]
Emerald hour, let the brass come through,
Green sparkle and a front-row view.
I'll send a rhythm, you send a smile,
We'll make this room dance for a while.

[Outro]
Last bright chord and one small bow,
Save that table, I'm coming down.

Title: After the Applause
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Round little suns in a dressing-room row,
Someone has swept all the glitter below.
Black sequin jacket on the back of my chair,
One drop of orange blossom sweetens the air.
You lean in the doorway, a coat on your arm,
Wearing that smile that unbuttons my charm.
I practice a bow for an audience of two;
The mirror gets one, and the other is you.

[Chorus]
After the applause, before we call a car,
Stay here a minute, exactly as you are.
No grand entrance, no clever disguise,
Just the little golden lamps reflected in your eyes.
After the applause, the sweetest part begins:
You laugh, I lose my line, and everybody wins.

[Verse 2]
A bobby pin rolls to the edge of the tray,
You catch it and claim that's your trick for the day.
I offer my perfume; you offer your wrist,
Then steal the last chocolate I somehow had missed.
The hallway is humming a song out of tune,
We dance for a moment with no extra room.

[Chorus]
After the applause, before we call a car,
Stay here a minute, exactly as you are.
No grand entrance, no clever disguise,
Just the little golden lamps reflected in your eyes.

[Bridge]
Let the curtain rest,
Let the houselights glow.
I have somewhere good to go.

[Final Chorus]
After the applause, the sweetest part begins:
You laugh, I lose my line, and everybody wins.

Title: Violet Coordinates
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Violet dusk on the water tower,
The city changes its coat by the hour.
A train writes silver beneath our street,
You tap the rail to the passing beat.
My ponytails catch in the rooftop breeze,
Your jacket flutters against your knees.
We trade directions in colored light:
The noodle-shop sign, then a turn to the right.

[Chorus]
Meet me at the violet coordinates,
Where the busy city finally waits.
North of the billboards, west of the moon,
You and I have the best little view.
No secret password, no signal to prove,
Just a place beside me with room for you.

[Verse 2]
The windows below make a patchwork screen,
Gold against indigo, pink against green.
You name a constellation after a crane,
I name one after the last subway train.
Two paper cups and a terrible joke,
A little white cloud from the tea when I spoke.
The whole bright district is moving along;
We find our own tempo inside of its song.

[Chorus]
Meet me at the violet coordinates,
Where the busy city finally waits.
North of the billboards, west of the moon,
You and I have the best little view.

[Bridge]
Let every avenue glitter below.
We can take our time before we go.

[Final Chorus]
Violet coordinates, warm in the blue,
A whole wide city and this view with you.

Title: Borrow My Hat
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The floor shines bright; the brass has a bite,
The corner band is getting it right.
I straighten my tie, give the brim a small tap,
You point to the beat with a casual clap.
That column has borrowed enough of your time;
Come over here, put your shoulder by mine.
The room makes a circle, the trumpet says please,
We answer in steps that are easy as these.

[Chorus]
Borrow my hat, I'll borrow your grin,
Leave a little space, then come back in.
Left goes the question, right goes the rhyme,
We can make an evening out of keeping time.
Borrow my hat, tilt it just like that,
Now the whole room wants to know where we are at.

[Verse 2]
Your first little shuffle gets louder applause
Than all of my practiced theatrical pause.
I laugh in the middle and miss my own cue;
The drummer politely pretends it was you.
We circle the table, come home to the floor,
The singer sees trouble and gives us some more.

[Chorus]
Borrow my hat, I'll borrow your grin,
Leave a little space, then come back in.
Left goes the question, right goes the rhyme,
We can make an evening out of keeping time.

[Bridge]
Nobody's counting except for the band;
One little bow, and offer your hand.

[Final Chorus]
Borrow my hat, tilt it just like that,
We brought the fun and we're taking it back.

Title: Salt on the Speakers
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
White cotton sleeves in the saltwater air,
A ribbon of sunshine caught up in your hair.
The boards of the pier have a rhythm to share,
And somebody brought out a folding chair.
You lean on the railing and wave me across;
I nearly forget where the next little step was.

[Chorus]
There's salt on the speakers, sun on the sound,
A bright little afternoon going around.
Come where the sea makes the bass line roll,
Bring your easy laugh and your lemon-yellow soul.
Salt on the speakers, blue in the sky,
We have all this daylight; let's give it a try.

[Verse 2]
The dancers in white make a loosely drawn ring,
No one agrees what the seagulls should sing.
You give an impression, the whole circle cheers,
I think we'll be telling that story for years.
We pause for the ferry and shade both our eyes,
A cloud looks like toast, which you solemnly prize.

[Chorus]
There's salt on the speakers, sun on the sound,
A bright little afternoon going around.
Come where the sea makes the bass line roll,
Bring your easy laugh and your lemon-yellow soul.

[Bridge]
Let the tide turn gently,
Let the music play.
We'll take the long way.

[Final Chorus]
Salt on the speakers, blue in the sky,
One more little dance before we say goodbye.

Title: One Seat in a Thousand
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A thousand bright rectangles climb the wall,
Blue rivers turn to gold above the hall.
My white gown gathers light along the hem,
The orchestra begins its silver thread.
You lift your hand without a grand display;
I find a steady smile and start to play.

[Chorus]
One seat in a thousand, one familiar face,
One small wave that settles into place.
All these colors rising, all this room to sing,
I can share the wonder of the whole bright thing.
One seat in a thousand, quiet as can be,
Thank you for being here to see it with me.

[Verse 2]
The screens become a garden made of rain,
Then turn to painted birds and back again.
A tiny paper star falls past my sleeve;
You catch it like a very special leaf.
The room becomes a warm and rolling sea,
You hold that paper star up just for me.

[Chorus]
One seat in a thousand, one familiar face,
One small wave that settles into place.
All these colors rising, all this room to sing,
I can share the wonder of the whole bright thing.

[Bridge]
When every screen grows dim,
We'll keep the evening in.

[Final Chorus]
One seat in a thousand, quiet as can be,
Thank you for being here to see it with me.

Title: Room for Tomorrow
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Blue on the ceiling and blue on the stairs,
Light moving slowly through silver squares.
I cross the room in a shimmer of gray,
You move your bag so there's space where I stay.
You add a window to catch morning views;
I pick a couch in a shade we both choose.

[Chorus]
Make room for tomorrow, leave a light in the hall,
We don't need to plan the dimensions of it all.
A little more laughter, a table for two,
A place for the things that we still want to do.
Make room for tomorrow, with plenty to spare;
I'll bring the music if you bring a chair.

[Verse 2]
The steps seem to float, but we take them in time,
You count all the corners and I count the chimes.
Our plans are in pencil, our tea has gone cold,
We change the whole kitchen from silver to gold.
We open the curtains and see what comes through,
The morning has painted the distance anew.

[Chorus]
Make room for tomorrow, leave a light in the hall,
We don't need to plan the dimensions of it all.
A little more laughter, a table for two,
A place for the things that we still want to do.

[Bridge]
One small beginning,
One sunny chair,
Let's put it there.

[Final Chorus]
Make room for tomorrow, with plenty to spare;
I'll bring the music if you bring a chair.

Title: Two Tickets, No Hurry
Lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A bus puts its headlights on soft in the dusk,
The bench smells of cedar and yesterday's dust.
You stand by the shelter, your coat buttoned wrong,
I turn with a grin before walking along.
The driver is checking the names on his sheet;
I hold up two tickets and point to your seat.

[Chorus]
Two tickets, no hurry, a road we can share,
One window for watching the world over there.
We'll find a small diner and argue for pie,
Then pick out the funniest cloud in the sky.
Two tickets, no hurry, come travel with me;
There's more than one good place for both of us to be.

[Verse 2]
You bring all the snacks like you're feeding a crew,
I packed a light sweater and nothing else new.
We settle our bags while the radio hums,
The town gives a wave as the wheels start to run.
A water tower blushes, the streetlights unfold,
You tell me a story you've never quite told.
